_candidate_name: Candidate 1: L1/L2 product-side priority with explicit L3 budget ledger
_candidate_note: Keeps L1 hard gate and L2 three-factor bucket multipliers unchanged. Layer 3 no longer treats failed product-sides as redistributable budget by default: base budget is computed over all candidate product-sides, passed sides receive bucket multipliers, excess budget is capped, and unused budget can remain idle.
